releases.name: v0.4.0
releases.notes:
⚠️  This contains a couple of breaking changes in how the ValkeyCluster spec is defined.

Notably updates below. A big thank you to the contributors in this release! 🎉 

## Breaking

### New `spec.scheduling` API

- #301
- #310 

We have moved these fields from the spec:

```yaml
spec:
  affinity:
  tolerations:
  topologySpreadConstraints:
  nodeSelector:
  priorityClassName:
```

They are now located under the `spec.scheduling` field:

```yaml
spec:
  scheduling:
    affinity:
    tolerations:
    topologySpreadConstraints:
    nodeSelector:
    priorityClassName:
```

We have also introduced first-class support for node spread topologies:

```yaml
spec:
  scheduling:
    node:
      spread:
        shard:
          mode: Disabled
        primaries:
          mode: Disabled
        pods:
          mode: Disabled
```

If you were previously using this configuration to prevent pods in a shard colocating on the same node:

```yaml
spec:
  topologySpreadConstraints:
  - maxSkew: 1
    topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
    whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
```

Then you will want to use this instead:

```yaml
spec:
  scheduling:
    node:
      spread:
        shard:
          mode: Required
```

This now uses a pod anti affinity under the hood instead of a topology spread constraint. Switching to this prevents a conflict in constraints should another be defined against the topology key used for spreading on hosts, against a `whenUnsatisfiable` condition.

See the Scheduling docs for more info:

- https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/blob/493f655449c869527326a11875c312629395d3e0/docs/valkeycluster.md#scheduling

### podDisruptionBudget refactor

- #308 

`spec.podDisruptionBudget` is no longer a string but now a struct.

`spec.podDisruptionBudget: Managed` is now the equivalent of:

```yaml
spec:
  podDisruptionBudget:
    mode: Cluster
```

`spec.podDisruptionBudget: Disabled` is now the equivalent of:

```yaml
spec:
  podDisruptionBudget:
    mode: Disabled
```

## Added

- `priorityClassName` to `ValkeyCluster.spec`
- `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` to `ValkeyCluster.spec`
- You can now pull in valkey-operator as a go module via `go get github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator`

## Fixed

- Resharding via atomic slot migration now works again


## What's Changed
* chore(deps): bump docker/build-push-action from 7.2.0 to 7.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/291
* test: add default user password for e2e cluster test by @tkarger in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/292
* feat: add priorityClassName to ValkeyCluster and ValkeyNode specs by @Sagar2366 in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/294
* feat: configurable terminationGracePeriodSeconds for graceful failover by @melancholictheory in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/271
* chore: Permit operator user to execute ROLE cmd by @jdheyburn in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/298
* refactor(api)!: move scheduling fields under spec.scheduling by @jdheyburn in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/301
* refactor!: convert podDisruptionBudget to struct with mode field by @jdheyburn in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/308
* fix: allow _replication user to apply atomic slot migration by @sandeepkunusoth in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/306
* Updated issue templates [bug_report and feature_request] by @sandeepkunusoth in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/179
* docs: rewrite dev.guide for local runs using kind and add macOS support by @bjosv in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/193
* feat: implement scheduling against node axis by @jdheyburn in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/310
* fix!: Rename go module to github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator by @deepakpunjabi in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/316
* fix: scheduling correct internal imports by @jdheyburn in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/322
* fix: stop updating workloads on every reconcile by owning API-server defaults by @matka12 in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/317

## New Contributors

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0

releases.name: v0.3.0
releases.notes:
This release of valkey-operator comes with incremental bug fixes and stability improvements. Notable additions include:

- Added dedicated user for replication
- Configure Valkey with `shutdown-on-sigterm failover` by default
- Adding Prometheus metrics
- Add `podSecurityContext` field to ValkeyCluster and ValkeyNode CRDs
- Add `metrics.exporter.securityContext` field to ValkeyCluster CRD to override the SecurityContext applied to the exporter sidecar
- Failover now targets the replica with the highest replication offset
- Cluster recovery when a majority of primaries are lost
- `spec.shards` is now required on ValkeyCluster resources; manifests that omit it will be rejected after the CRD upgrade

## What's Changed
* Filter Secrets by managed-by label to reduce cache memory usage by @bjosv in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/238
* fix: recover cluster when majority of primaries are lost by @bjosv in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/244
* feat: add operator-specific Prometheus metrics by @daanvinken in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/159
* (bug) fixed Liveness and Readiness Probes to use operator managed user instead of default user by @sandeepkunusoth in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/235
* fix: roll primaries shard-by-shard during rolling update without persistence by @bjosv in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/252
* chore(kubebuilder): update scaffold v4.14.0 -> v4.15.0 by @sandeepkunusoth in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/254
* feat: fail over to the highest-offset replica by @melancholictheory in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/249
* fix: scale-down blocked when excess shard pod is unschedulable by @daanvinken in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/258
* fix: surface ValkeyNode reconcile errors in status conditions by @daanvinken in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/257
* fix: filter excess shard pods in scheduling issue check by @daanvinken in https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/pull/273

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.notes:
This is our second alpha release of Valkey Operator which includes several features, improvements, and bug fixes since the last iteration, notables include:

- Configuration applied live against nodes, without the need of rolling the pods
  - Only a small subset of configurations supported currently
- Deploy a minimal pod disruption budget to ensure only 1 node in a cluster is disrupted
- Support a topology spread constraint, allowing primaries and replicas of a shard to be placed on different Kubernetes nodes
- Roll true replicas first before primaries
- Support images from private container registries
- Reduce the memory of the operator when deployed to a larger cluster
- Support for alpine images
- Several cluster stability improvements and fixes

Upgrading in-place is not supported, you may have to tear down your Valkey Cluster and redeploy it.

A huge thank you to all the contributors in this release! 🎉

releases.notes:
First alpha release of valkey-operator, supporting ValkeyCluster CRDs with some basic lifecycling operations.

This release serves as an initial release to begin testing the operator in non-production environments.

Please note: This is still in active development, breaking changes against the alpha CRD are expected. Data loss can be expected in this early release. Do not run this in production.
